assessment.scope: ILCD2010 selected terminology, Situation A explanation and formal provisions; PEF2021/2279 original and official2022 English correction section4.5 plus section1 comparison conditions. Existing work/carrier identities reused; no full-work or all-version reading claim.
assessment.comparison: Complete-basket reporting can align conditionally. ILCD general Situation A uses an eligible consumption-market proxy and its specific absorption rule. PEF direct substitution requires the prior step to be unavailable, a direct empirical effect and directly representative LCI; PEFCR comparison qualification remains separate.
assessment.controls: A stipulated evidence sequence distinguishes equivalent supply/scale, direct switch information and inventory representativeness. Conditional equality of entire reference vectors does not establish equal evidence duties or joint rule applicability. No forced sign reversal, new numerical case or empirical implementation claim.
assessment.findings: Independent source findings corrected Step3 justification for the chosen rule as well as discarding earlier steps, and separated technical service comparability from actual substitution. Formal ILCD fallback retains its conjunction despite broader explanatory wording. Subsequent precise residual wording and the ninth closing claim received bounded independent source/logic reread.
assessment.conservation: All earlier canonical claims/evidence, case inputs/templates/components and older reading/passages/order remain. Two existing sources and two reading appraisals are explicitly extended, not silently relabeled as whole-work reading. The unchanged252-consumer closure retains its original premise/evidence/carrier identities; this is not a new full scientific review of every consumer.
assessment.permission: ISO preview pages were visible during investigation. Later observed official AI-use restrictions have no corresponding task authorization; no new substantive ISO claim enters this unit. The permission/full-standard gap and actual limited inspection remain explicit.
